mostWorthwhile.text: Opening the wicket with a resident's fob and bringing the supplies through gave the earlier repair and local control a tangible payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the released supplies at the passage and then the configured reader before the wicket was open was confusing; neither failure explained the missing prerequisite.

surprise.text: The cart first needed the collection request checked against the courier's record, despite already being at the boundary.

arbitrary.text: The configured reader having no available operation until the supplies reached the door was understandable in hindsight, but the failure gave no indication of that dependency.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the repaired wicket and locally verified delivery made earlier infrastructure choices feel consequential, and Asha's slow tap suggests more practical work ahead.
